name: Attio
description: Attio lets agents search records, update deals, log notes, and create tasks in the workspace of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Attio account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which open deals had no activity in the last two weeks?
Log a note on the Acme deal with the points from today's call.
Create a task to follow up with this contact next Tuesday.

apps.name: Attio
apps.description: Record search, deal updates, notes, and tasks, over Attio's MCP server with browser sign-in.
